# ResCutes

> Philippine animal rescue coordination - from citizen report to shelter intake, medical clearance, and adoption.

## Main

- [Home](https://rescutes.vercel.app/): Product overview and demo access
- [Sign In](https://rescutes.vercel.app/login): Demo login for citizen, rescuer, staff, veterinarian, and admin roles
- [Terms of use](https://rescutes.vercel.app/terms): Demo terms and acceptable use

## Product

ResCutes is a coordinated rescue workflow for citizens, field rescuers, shelters, and veterinarians. Public pages describe the product; signed-in web and mobile apps handle live case operations.
